default.summary.en:
LynxTransportClient is the client transport implementation for webpack-dev-server.
It can be used in the
[`devServer.client.webSocketTransport`](https://webpack.js.org/configuration/dev-server/#websockettransport)
configuration of webpack.
default.summary.text:
LynxTransportClient 是 webpack-dev-server 的客户端传输实现。可用于 webpack 的
[`devServer.client.webSocketTransport`](https://webpack.js.org/configuration/dev-server/#websockettransport)
配置中。

Client.summary.en: Client is the interface that [`webpack-dev-server`](https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-server/blob/48f56d57775dc4cf78bfcf51c3761adf852b0310/client-src/socket.js#L30) uses for a websocket client.
Client.summary.text: Client 是 [`webpack-dev-server`](https://github.com/webpack/webpack-dev-server/blob/48f56d57775dc4cf78bfcf51c3761adf852b0310/client-src/socket.js#L30) 用于 WebSocket 客户端的接口。
